SHARED-F-2-S23.title: Consent Workflow Core Logic (Tier 1 vs Tier 2)
SHARED-F-2-S23.description: Implement core consent_service logic to handle two-tier HIPAA consent workflow, including tier classification, de-identification for Tier 1, full data allowance for Tier 2, and conversation summarization prior to storage.

SHARED-F-2-S24.title: Consent Framework Unit and Integration Tests
SHARED-F-2-S24.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating consent tier enforcement, de-identification behavior, API validation, and tool_router enforcement paths. Cover edge cases including missing consent, tier escalation, and invalid inputs.
